description: This file defines functions and interfaces for loading and managing language parsers using web-tree-sitter, including dynamic loading of language WASM modules based on file extensions, and handling parser initialization.

methods.name: loadLanguage
methods.description: Loads a language WASM module given a language name and optional source directory.

methods.name: loadRequiredLanguageParsers
methods.description: Asynchronously loads necessary language parsers based on file extensions in the provided list, initializing web-tree-sitter and returning a map of language parsers and queries.
